method.description: Controlled physiological series from published resting-HR / HRV / sleep distributions with injected deterioration. Detector = production early-warning (v2.1 weights).
references: Cooney MT et al. Eur J Prev Cardiol 2010.
Cappuccio FP et al. Eur Heart J 2011.

limitations: Streams are synthetic, grounded in published vital distributions — not labelled real outcomes.
Weights tuned on these controlled series; not prospectively validated in clinic.
No open-licence South-Asian wearable outcome cohort was available for this PoC.
